messages:
maya: Quick week0 snapshot for Northbridge private/VPC onboarding — want to consolidate blockers and owners. Primary items: networking (peering, NAT, ports), IAM/KMS access for CMEK, and audit-log export. We have a 4‑week target to avoid renewal risk exposure; if customer stalls >2 weeks we escalate. Who can own each item?

jordan (Northbridge): Thanks — I can coordinate on our side. FW team needs exact egress targets and NAT requirements. Also want to confirm audit log format (CloudAudit / syslog) for our SIEM.

samir: I can take networking. Short checklist from our side:
```
- Provide Redwood egress IP ranges (we'll whitelist)
- Open outbound 443 to those ranges from the VPC NAT
- Allow inbound from Redwood peering range for control plane (TCP 443)
- Ensure route table has peering target for subnets used by Redwood agents
```
Also: do you plan to use a NAT gateway or egress-only instance? that affects SNAT IPs.

jordan (Northbridge): We'll use NAT gateways. FYI our infra team only exposes a small set of static egress IPs, so if you can share the exact list that'd be ideal.

eli: On KMS/IAM: customer needs to add our service principal to the key policy with encrypt/decrypt and iam:PassRole for the CMEK role. Minimal example policy snippet below — please adapt to your key ARNs.
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "RedwoodAccess",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDBOX:role/redwood-inference-cmek"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```
Note: customer key rotation is fine; just confirm key policy includes the redwood role. Also we recommend grant only write-to-audit for logging sinks (see below).

maya: Action owners: networking -> samir; KMS/IAM -> eli; audit logs -> maya + jordan to confirm destination. Timeline: samir to share exact egress IPs + port list today; eli to share a template key policy by EOD; jordan to confirm SIEM format and S3/bucket details. I'll follow up with PR for runbook updates.

deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: "Northbridge week0 onboarding — network & security" Thu 10:00 AM (invite link: https://calendar.example.com/evt/abcd1234) :calendar:

samir: Quick note on ports — we only need outbound 443 for control/metrics and 8443 for model-agent telemetry (TLS). If you have strict egress rules please allow both. Example rule: `TCP 443, 8443 -> 203.0.113.0/24` (replace with Redwood IPs).

jordan (Northbridge): Understood. Also for audit logs: we forward to Splunk via HTTPS; retention 365 days. Do you need a dedicated S3 bucket or do you prefer a direct push to our collector endpoint?

eli: Either is fine. If using S3 we require SSE-KMS with the CMEK key and an IAM role allowing `s3:PutObject` from Redwood logging principal. If pushing to your collector, we need a write-only service account with TLS client certs. We'll draft both examples.

maya: Quick capture of risk: if KMS key policy isn't finalized within 7 days we lose the 4-week target (cloud ops needs lead time). Jordan — would you be able to get your security team to sign the policy template?

jordan (Northbridge): I'll loop them in after your template lands. Expect a 48–72h turnaround from our security.

maya: Thanks — two small asks for feedback capture: 1) was anything in onboarding docs confusing? 2) any missing examples we should add (KMS policy, firewall template, audit sink example)?

jordan (Northbridge): Docs are very thorough, big +1 for the network diagrams. Missing piece: an explicit KMS key policy example for cross-account service principals — that's the step that tripped our infra lead. If you add that + a sample `awscli` command to attach the policy it would be perfect.

maya: Great — I'll add a cross-account KMS example and an `awscli` snippet. Will open a PR to the runbook and paste link here when done. Also flagging as low renewal risk for now (green) provided we keep momentum. :white_check_mark:

samir: I'll post the egress CIDRs later today and a quick firewall template you can paste to your team.

eli: Template KMS policy and S3 sink role will be in this thread by EOD.

maya: Awesome — thanks all. Will update the ticket and follow up in the invite. :thumbsup:
